manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Lists the public RAR hologram DOGG channel and asks a local RAPP Zoo to summon a named, hash-verified character or data projection. Downloads data only; the zoo owns the sandboxed renderer.
manifest.name: @kody-w/hologram_dogg

action.description: List, dimension-match, catch one DOGG, or inspect local bottles.

frame_json.description: Optional RAPP frame whose payload supplies match dimensions.

hologram_id.description: RAR DOGG id, for example holo-avatar.

query.description: Natural-language dimensions to match against cached bottles.
